pattern: いかんにかかわらず / いかんによらず / いかんをとわず
aliases: ikan ni kakawarazu / ikan ni yorazu / ikan o towazu
purpose: Remove a factor from consideration in a formal rule.
keywords: N（の）+ いかんにかかわらず / いかんによらず / いかんを問わず
We cannot issue refunds, whatever the reason.
Everyone receives training regardless of experience.
Report the result whether it succeeds or fails.
formation: N（の）+ いかんにかかわらず / いかんによらず / いかんを問わず
restrictions: Often found in eligibility rules and official statements.
mistake: Unlike いかんでは, this says the factor does not matter.
